# Matcha — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where does Matcha come from?", "Japan"),
    ("What is Matcha made of?", "green (powdered); shade-grown, stone-ground"),

    ("What is base?", "green (powdered); shade-grown, stone-ground"),
    ("What is serving?", "whisked frothy"),
    ("What is note?", "Tea ceremony soul"),
]

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
